topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I hardly knew what to do when I stumbled upon it, my words hanging there on the screen like a confession I hadn’t intended to make. There it was, my college application essay, a plaster cast of my thoughts frozen in time, now on display for the world to scrutinize. It wasn’t just the shock of seeing it out in the open; it was the realization that every keystroke, every moment of hesitation, every word was now public. I never meant for it to be seen like this, a piece of me laid bare. I felt the room close in, the walls leaning forward as if to whisper that this was real, this was happening. What am I supposed to do now? Who else has seen this?
